prOriginal.nota: No PR: the benchmark head 267d8be1 (Arpit Jalan) is itself an upstream commit pushed directly to main (committer date 2015-08-11, ancestor of main per compare API; commits/{sha}/pulls is empty). Merged code equals the benchmark head.

ux-show-complete-url-path-if-website-dom.reason: PR #4158 'Show website path in website name for all domains' replaced the case-sensitive host comparison with uri.host + uri.path for every host, so an uppercase host matching the instance now keeps its path. Today user_card_serializer.rb website_name is uri.host.sub(/\Awww\./,'') + uri.path with no comparison.

astra.pergunta: Given PR #4158 (2016-04-11) replacing the domain comparison with uri.host + uri.path for all domains, a10c9397 (2017-06-04) adding website_name to untrusted_attributes, and #14407 (2021-09-22) deleting the dead include_website_name: status for #01/#04/#05/#06/#07?
astra.resposta: #01 confirmado by #4158 (uppercase hosts now keep the path); #04 descontinuado by #4158 (classification removed, full path for all hosts is now intended policy); #05 confirmado by #4158; #06 confirmado by a10c9397; #07 confirmado by a10c9397 (first behavioural fix, #14407 is cleanup); the '.' << literal claim is not a bug.

ux-show-complete-url-path-if-website-dom.reason: PR #4158 removed the first-label-stripping same-domain check entirely; full path is now shown for all hosts by design, so the misclassification no longer exists, but the change was a policy change, not a fix of the classification.
